name: runner-closing-ownership
goal: A member of a command's group is the command's only beside one of its own in the same table; nothing is claimed at reaping. Evidence says who was signalled and who was not.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Review block: the first table after closed() owned group member 70 with no anchor, and a TERM survivor was reported as not signalled. Expected: unproven, never signalled, fails; truthful wording.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Final test files on preserved pre-repair sources in an isolated tree: 7 failed, 52 passed of 59. Log /tmp/harness-ownership-red-final.log; hashes /tmp/harness-ownership-hashes.txt.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Removed the closing flag in processDescendants; the report says signalled but still running and counts it; one failure sentence added. Two fixtures gained readiness waits, assertions kept.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same test files on the repaired source: 59 passed in three full runs; records 15, desktop 7. Logs /tmp/harness-ownership-green-1..3.log, -records.log, -desktop.log.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
